accessSummary: Global · API key or keyless tier
title: You.com · Search and Contents free tier
why: You.com combines a keyless daily Search tier with a separate dollar credit allowance and low-cost Contents extraction.
mechanism: 100 Web Search queries/day, $100 new-account credits, Search $5/1,000 calls and Contents $1/1,000 pages
validity: Daily Search limit; credits and pricing follow account terms
access: Global; free Search can run without credentials, full APIs use a key
command: Use the keyless Search tier for evaluation or create a YOU_API_KEY for the full API set.
quota: 100 queries / day; $100 new-account credits; Search $5 / 1,000 calls
renewal: Daily free Search limit resets daily; credit terms are account-controlled
evidence: Official pricing lists 100 daily Search queries, $100 free credits, $5/1,000 Search calls and $1/1,000 Contents pages.
notes: Keyless free Search and keyed full APIs are separate access paths.

usageGuide.summary: 使用 You.com Search 或 Contents API
prerequisites: Search 评估可使用免费层
完整 API 需要 YOU_API_KEY
steps: 打开官方 Quickstart 并选择 keyless Search 或 API key 路径
设置 YOU_API_KEY（如果使用完整 API）
发送 Search 请求并记录每日用量

examples.curl: curl --request POST https://api.you.com/v1/search --header 'Authorization: Bearer ${YOU_API_KEY}' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"query":"latest AI news"}'

quotaGuard: Contents 按 pages 计费，不要把页面数当成请求数

commonIssues.solution: 创建 API key 后使用完整工具集

name: Firecrawl Web APIs
providerMeta: Search, scrape and crawl APIs · Global
title: Firecrawl · Search and scrape free plan
why: Firecrawl uses one credit balance across Search, Scrape, Crawl, Map and browser interaction with explicit free limits.
mechanism: 1,000 credits/month; Search costs 2 credits per 10 results, scrape/crawl/map cost 1 credit per page
validity: Monthly credits reset under the free plan; pay-as-you-go is a paid-plan feature
command: Create a Firecrawl API key and call the Search or Scrape endpoint within the monthly credit limit.
quota: 1,000 credits / month; 500 searches or 1,000 pages scraped; 10 requests/minute
renewal: Free credits reset monthly; free plan does not auto-charge overage
evidence: Official pricing lists 1,000 credits/month, 500 searches or 1,000 pages, 2 concurrent requests and a 10/minute free rate limit.
notes: Agent has a separate preview allowance of 5 daily runs; do not equate it with Search credits.

usageGuide.summary: 用 Firecrawl Search 或 Scrape 获取网页内容
steps: 打开官方 API 文档创建 API Key
设置 FIRECRAWL_API_KEY 环境变量
先用 Search 或 Scrape 验证返回内容并监控 credits

examples.curl: curl --request POST https://api.firecrawl.dev/v2/search --header 'Authorization: Bearer ${FIRECRAWL_API_KEY}' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"query":"latest AI news","limit":5}'

quotaGuard: Search 每 10 个结果消耗 2 credits
免费层 10 requests/minute 和 2 concurrent requests

commonIssues.solution: 减少结果数并分别核对 Search、Scrape、Crawl 的计费单位

name: Brave Search API
title: Brave Search API · free monthly credits
why: Brave Search applies $5 of free credits every month to its Search API and publishes a 50 QPS capacity.
mechanism: $5 free credits/month at $5 per 1,000 Search requests
validity: Free credits are automatically applied monthly under account terms
access: Global; API key and account required
command: Create a Brave Search API key and send a Web Search request.
renewal: Free credits apply monthly; usage beyond credits is paid
evidence: Official API page lists $5 free monthly credits, $5/1,000 requests and 50 queries per second.
notes: The free amount is dollar-denominated; one month of free credits is roughly 1,000 standard requests at the listed price.

usageGuide.summary: 调用 Brave Search API 获取实时搜索结果
steps: 打开官方 API 页面并创建 API Key
设置 BRAVE_API_KEY 环境变量
发送 Web Search 请求并监控月度 credits
quotaGuard: 超过每月 $5 credits 后确认付费设置

commonIssues.solution: 确认 X-Subscription-Token 使用的是 Brave API key

name: Browserbase Web APIs
providerMeta: Browser, Search and Fetch infrastructure · Global
title: Browserbase · free browser and web APIs
why: Browserbase packages browser runtime with free Search, Fetch and Agent allowances in one free plan.
mechanism: 1 browser hour, 3 Agent runs, 1,000 Search calls and 1,000 Fetch calls; 3 concurrent browsers
validity: Free plan allowances subject to current pricing rules; sessions capped at 15 minutes
access: Global; free plan with 3 concurrent browsers
command: Create a Browserbase project, set BROWSERBASE_API_KEY, and start a short browser session.
quota: 1 browser hour; 3 Agent runs; 1,000 Search calls; 1,000 Fetch calls; 3 concurrent browsers
renewal: Free plan limits are account-controlled; paid usage requires plan rules
evidence: Official pricing lists free browser hours, Agent runs, Search calls, Fetch calls, concurrency and session duration.
notes: Browser hours, Search calls and Fetch calls are separate units and should not be compared as equivalent requests.

usageGuide.summary: 用 Browserbase 免费层启动浏览器并调用 Search/Fetch
steps: 打开官方价格页创建项目
设置 BROWSERBASE_API_KEY 和项目 ID
启动不超过 15 分钟的浏览器会话并主动关闭
quotaGuard: 免费层只有 1 browser hour 和 15-minute session cap
Search、Fetch 和 Agent 各自消耗不同单位

commonIssues.solution: 拆分任务并在完成后调用关闭会话接口
